_comment: OPM occupational series -> PivotHop occupation slug. USAJOBS stamps every posting with its federal series (JobCategory Code; sources/usajobs.js keeps it as job_series). Used only when the title does not map (normalize/index.js), so it never moves a posting the title matcher already placed. Mapped 2026-10-01 from the OPM handbook and checked against where each series' mapped titles already land (fresh USAJOBS pull, 8,908 postings). A posting whose series point to different occupations (interdisciplinary announcements) does not map. Catch-all series and series whose pay would skew a band are left out; see _skipped.

_skipped.0007: Correctional Officer: the titles that do not already map are probation officers (21-1092), not police
_skipped.0081: Fire Protection and Prevention: firefighter is not an occupation yet (lexicon step 5, part 2)
_skipped.0101: Social Science: case managers, counselors and analysts in one series
_skipped.0189: Recreation Aid and Assistant: no occupation
_skipped.0301: Miscellaneous Administration and Program: catch-all (customer support, admin, project managers in one series)
_skipped.0343: Management and Program Analysis: the titles already map; what falls through is merchandise planners and tip-line analysts
_skipped.0610: Nurse: the unmapped titles are nurse anesthetists, not RNs
_skipped.0622: Medical Supply Technician: sterile processing, not an occupation yet
_skipped.0640: Health Aid and Technician: EMT, dietetic, ophthalmic and CMA in one series
_skipped.0649: Medical Instrument Technician: sonography, EKG, EEG; sonographer not an occupation yet
_skipped.0675: Medical Records Technician: no occupation (health-informatics-specialist is 15-1211, about twice the pay)
_skipped.0679: Medical Support Assistant: the titles already map
_skipped.1801: General Inspection, Investigation and Enforcement: catch-all
_skipped.1811: Criminal Investigating: detectives (33-3021), paid above police-officer
_skipped.1910: Quality Assurance: federal QA specialists earn about twice a quality inspector; would skew that pay band
_skipped.2005: Supply Technician: stock and supply clerks, no occupation
_skipped.2210: IT Management: titles that do not map are leadership (Deputy CIO), not support
